scope: Re-run the frozen PE16 DATAFLOW board protocol from the existing RAM-Linux UART shell and update the first-order image-latency projection.

first_order_image_projection.method: Replace eligible CPU MUL_MAT time in the frozen full-image baseline by eligible FLOPs divided by the newly measured representative PL throughput; retain non-eligible CPU time and 8-token decode; add the previously measured fast-path bridge estimate.

limitations: This is a board measurement of accelerator microbenchmarks, not an end-to-end RoboBrain image inference.
The complete GGML/llama.cpp Transformer backend is not connected to the PL kernel yet.
The 538.7 s projection remains optimistic for unmeasured small and transposed operator shapes and excludes complete backend scheduling effects.
Per-operator PS round trips are a bring-up path only and are rejected as the final architecture.
